svg.title: Lepton 3.5 to Raspberry Pi 4 Model B and Pi 5 wiring
svg.desc: Seven connections: J3 pin 1 ground to Pi physical 6; J3 pin 2 VIN to Pi 2; J2 pin 5 SDA to Pi 3; J2 pin 8 SCL to Pi 5; J2 pin 12 MISO to Pi 21; J2 pin 7 clock to Pi 23; J2 pin 10 chip select to Pi 24. Pin maps show connector numbering. Power off before wiring.
svg.text: Lepton 3.5 + Breakout Board v2.0 • Pi 4 Model B / Pi 5 • Lepton Lab
POWER OFF BEFORE WIRING • Pi numbers below are PHYSICAL header positions, not GPIO numbers.
7 wires • short jumper leads • use J3 for power • leave factory J5–J9 jumpers fitted
J2 signal header · camera-socket side · pin 1 at upper left
Square pad marks pin 1. Numbering runs across in pairs.
Locate J2 and J3 on your board;
Do not mirror the solder-side view.
Top / component side · pin 1 at lower left
Identify pin 1 from the Pi board markings.
Same connections on both Pi models.
This is GPIO wiring, not the CSI ribbon socket.
VSYNC (J2 pin 15) and MOSI (J2 pin 9) are not required. CS uses CE0 / physical pin 24 by default.
5 V goes only to VIN. Never connect 5 V to GPIO signals or the breakout’s low-voltage rail pins.
Original diagram for Lepton Lab • Pin facts: FLIR Lepton v2.0 datasheet / Raspberry Pi guide; Raspberry Pi GPIO documentation.
Source links and CE1 alternative: WIRING.md • No third-party photographs or diagram artwork reproduced • 27 October 2026
